ARAB 121.description: Grammar and practical vocabulary necessary for fundamental communication skills. Assumes no prior experience in the language.
ARAB 121.subject: ARAB
ARAB 121.title: Elementary Arabic

ARAB 122.description: Practice and further development of essential listening, reading, speaking, and writing skills. Admission only by successful completion of Arabic 121. Offered only in spring.
ARAB 122.subject: ARAB
ARAB 122.title: Basic Proficiency in Arabic

ARAB 201.description: Continuation of reading, writing, and speaking Arabic.
ARAB 201.subject: ARAB
ARAB 201.title: Intermediate Arabic I

ARAB 202.description: Increased emphasis on reading and writing skills in Arabic.
ARAB 202.subject: ARAB
ARAB 202.title: Intermediate Arabic II

ARAB 280.description: Introduction to Arab culture (literature, music, film, and art) from the 19th century to the present.
ARAB 280.subject: ARAB
ARAB 280.title: Introduction to Modern Arab Culture

ARAB 301.description: This course builds on grammar and vocabulary by reading and listening to authentic Arabic materials. By semester’s end, the student will be able to write in detail and comprehend and use advanced vocabulary grammar and syntax in all forms of expression.
ARAB 301.subject: ARAB
ARAB 301.title: Advanced Arabic Language I

ARAB 302.description: This course is a continuation of ARAB 301 and builds on grammar and vocabulary by reading and listening to authentic Arabic materials. By semester’s end, the student will be able to write in detail and comprehend and use advanced vocabulary grammar and syntax.
ARAB 302.subject: ARAB
ARAB 302.title: Advanced Arabic Language II

ARAB 310.description: Practical drills in aural-oral skills to develop facility in the spoken language.
ARAB 310.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ARAB 202.
ARAB 310.subject: ARAB
ARAB 310.title: Colloquial Arabic I

ARAB 311.description: Continued instruction in colloquial (spoken) Arabic with a focus on oral and aural competencies, discussing aspects of the local culture, and working with media produced in the local variety of Arabic. Course may be repeated as the variety of Arabic may change.
ARAB 311.subject: ARAB
ARAB 311.title: Colloquial Arabic II

ARAB 320.description: Introduction to dominant trends and genres in nineteenth and twentieth century Arabic literature.
ARAB 320.subject: ARAB
ARAB 320.title: Introduction to Modern Arab Literature in Translation

ARAB 336.description: Introduction to writings by and about women writers from the Arab world from the 20th and 21st centuries. Taught in English.
ARAB 336.subject: ARAB
ARAB 336.title: Arab Women Writers

ARAB 398.description: Selected literary topics of the Arab world. May be repeated for credit under different titles. Taught in English.
ARAB 398.subject: ARAB
ARAB 398.title: Selected Topics

ARAB 399.description: Contract approved by instructor, advisor, and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
ARAB 399.subject: ARAB
ARAB 399.title: Independent Study

ARAB 401.description: Acquisition of advanced grammar and vocabulary. Increased focus on reading, writing, and discussion in Modern Standard Arabic.
ARAB 401.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ARAB 302 or equivalent.
ARAB 401.subject: ARAB
ARAB 401.title: Advanced Arabic I

ARAB 402.description: Continued acquisition of advanced grammar and vocabulary. Increased focus on reading, writing, and discussion in Modern Standard Arabic.
ARAB 402.subject: ARAB
ARAB 402.title: Advanced Arabic II

ARAB 615.description: Intensive reading for non-majors. Graduate students fulfill their foreign-language requirement with successful completion of the course. Undergraduates may take the course as an elective only. Grades S/U for graduates and undergraduates.
ARAB 615.subject: ARAB
ARAB 615.title: Intensive Readings in Arabic

ARAB 777.description: Supervised direction of foreign language teaching in college. Required of all graduate assistants who are teaching. This course will not count toward the MA or PhD degree.
ARAB 777.subject: ARAB
ARAB 777.title: Supervised Instruction in Teaching Foreign Languages in College
